entry.author: RNZ
entry.summary:
GST turns 40 this year and nowadays makes up about 30% of our total tax revenue every year | Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/RNZVideo?sub_confirmation=1

But since its introduction back in October 1986, economists and everyday folk have been questioning whether it’s a fair system for all, or if some households are affected more than others.

Listen to Susan Edmunds's No Stupid Questions podcast: https://www.rnz.co.nz/podcast/no-stupid-questions/2026/will-raising-the-rate-of-gst-affect-me-more-than-others
